finding.summary: Model-controlled issue fields are rendered without type validation. stage2 only marks a response malformed when entries aren't dicts, so an issue like {"file": null} or {"file": 123} passes that check (dict.get returns the null value, not the default), and then _code_span(iss.file) calls .splitlines() on a non-string (or sorted() raises TypeError comparing None to str). The exception propagates to main()'s broad handler, aborting the run so the entire multi-file review is discarded and nothing is posted — defeating the incomplete-file disclosure design, which intends this file to be flagged 'not fully reviewed' while the rest of the report still posts.
finding.fix: Coerce/validate in stage2 when building Issue (e.g. file=str(iss.get('file') or chunk.file_path), line coerced via int() with fallback None), or defensively in the formatter: skip/placeholder non-string files (file_text = iss.file if isinstance(iss.file, str) else str(iss.file)) and sort with key=lambda i: str(i.file).

label: false_positive
label_reason: Raised in review and merged with the file unchanged.
